Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted DuckDuckGo’s query normalization from “Hellogoodbye” to “Hello, Goodbye” (the Beatles song) and inferred that Frankie Valli performing “Hello, Goodbye” would satisfy the “Hellogoodbye” criterion. This conflated a song title with the band Hellogoodbye and relied on SERP snippets without verifying sources, leading to an incorrect provisional conclusion.
